about: The lab's desk as shown on the site: the bench under codenames, the bin and the dated log. Public words only. Nothing here says what an unshipped tool is or how it is made; the full entries, with their sources, stay in the lab's own records (ALEMBIC Mark 2). A codename keeps its number for life and takes its public name when the tool ships. make_lab.js refuses to print a figure an entry's own figures list does not hold.

bench.name: Project 01
bench.text: Through every check. Being finished for release.

bench.name: Project 02
bench.text: Thrown out once, rebuilt clean, still not good enough to look at. Dropped as a tool of its own. The one useful part goes to Project 01 to be counted.
bench.src: lab records, 25 Nov (RD_CARDS I-101; his choice of 12:34 in LAB_LOG)

bench.name: Project 03
bench.text: Built twice, clean both times. It adds too little beside the bar, so it waits on the shelf.
bench.src: lab records, 25 Nov (RD_CARDS B-101, B-102, D-101; SCOUT_CARDS shelf check; LAB_LOG ruling)

bench.name: Project 04
bench.text: Brought in, then thrown out by its own checks before a build.
bench.src: lab records, 25 Nov (SCOUT_CARDS kill questions, run VKTM)

bench.name: Project 06
bench.text: Counted before it was built, built clean, no repaint, nothing squashed. With me now, to compile and look at on my own chart.
bench.src: lab records, 26 Nov (RD_CARDS I-114 to I-120; QUANT_CARDS D-115, R-112, SQ-109; PUBLISH_CARDS EP-106)

bin.why: Written down in full before the data was opened, then counted on gold and silver. It did not beat what traders already use, so it does not get built.
Each was written down in full before the data was opened, then set against what traders already have on their charts and against chance. Neither did better, so neither gets built.

bin.why: Each was written down in full before the data was opened, then counted against chance on gold. None beat it.

bin.why: Each was counted against chance on gold before anything was built. None beat it.
bin.src: lab records (SCOUT_CARDS C-008 to C-011; QUANT_CARDS D-114, V-109)

bin.why: It passed the test the lab set, then failed a harder one: it told a trader nothing the candles do not already show.
bin.src: lab records (RD_CARDS B-103 and D-105; LAB_LOG 25 Nov 15:4x and 15:5x)

bin.why: Clean, but nobody could read it as a level. Dropped as a tool of its own.
It looked good on the day picked to show it, and did not hold up on a day nobody picked.

bin.what: The squeeze before a bigger move
bin.why: Gold moved less after a squeeze, not more.

bin.what: Swing highs and lows pulling price
bin.why: Reached as often as any level the same distance away.
Promised one close in twenty beyond it. Gold gave one in three.

bin.what: The slow half reading the day
bin.why: Gold's own candles, shuffled, scored higher.
It failed the chart, and I threw it out.
The whole engine scrapped and started again.

bin.what: My own call on the slow half
bin.why: I filed it as holding. The shuffle proved me wrong, and the verdict says so.

log.text: Two ideas in overnight. One thrown out by its own count. The other passed its first count on ten years held back, and now faces a harder test against simpler rivals before anything is built.
log.src: lab records (SCOUT_CARDS C-017, C-018; QUANT_CARDS D-121)

log.text: Two more ideas thrown out. Neither beat what is already on the shelf, one of them on two years held back on purpose.
Project 06 held up on ten more years of gold that nobody had counted before, every one of them.
Three more ideas thrown out overnight. One was tested on two years held back on purpose, and failed there too.
Project 06 went through all six checks and is with me to look at on my own chart.
Four ideas in, four thrown out, each counted against chance before a line of code. Nothing weak reached the bench.
Nothing below the half hour chart is counted, built or published from here.
Raised the bar. A tool now has to beat what plain geometry would show, named before the data is opened, not just a coin. Project 05 met the old bar, missed the new one and went in the bin.
Three more ideas thrown out. Nothing reached the bench.
log.src: lab records (SCOUT_CARDS, runs QRDW and WTHB)

log.text: Dropped Project 02 as a tool of its own. Its useful part goes to Project 01, to be counted first.
Tighter checks threw out four ideas in two runs. Nothing reached the bench, and that counts as a good run.
log.src: lab records (SCOUT_CARDS, runs VKTM and HMPL)

log.text: Threw out Project 04 before a build.
Built Project 03 twice. Clean both times, not good enough beside the bar. Parked.
Project 02 came back clean. Still not good enough to look at.
Project 02 rebuild started.
Threw out Project 02 on draft 7.
Project 04 came in.
Project 01 passed its replay. Not one drawing moved.
The Gate shipped on its 27th draft.
Ran my own slow line against shuffled candles. The shuffle won. Verdict corrected.
Counted the squeeze. It does not hold.
Counted swing highs and lows, and the channel wall. Neither holds.
Counted every clock behind a turn. A lead, not yet sealed.
